item.title: The Rev. Jesse Jackson, Who Led The Civil Rights Movement For Decades After King, Has Died At 84
item.description: By SOPHIA TAREEN Associated Press CHICAGO (AP) — The Rev. Jesse L. Jackson, a protege of the Rev. item.title: DHS Funding Is Sticking Point Of Govt Shutdown
item.description: A partial government shutdown centered on the Department of Homeland Security continues. It started when Congress withheld funding for DHS over the weekend over concerns about reforms to immigration enforcement. Lawmakers are now on a weeklong recess. The shutdown primarily effects Transportation Security Administration, the Federal Emergency Management Agency, the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Agency, U.S. Secret Service and the U.S. Coast Guard.

item.title: Still No Sign Of Nancy Guthrie
item.description: Weeks of searching in the desert Southwest have failed to find any trace of Nancy Guthrie. The 84-year-old mother of Today show co-host Savannah Guthrie was reported missing on February 1st from her home in the Tucson [[ Tu-sahn ]], Arizona area. The FBI is offering a 100-thousand-dollar reward in the case as authorities try to track down whoever may have abducted Nancy. The Pima County sheriff says her family members have all been ruled out as possible suspects.
